sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact ID gemini-3.7-flash; 1,048,576-token input; text/image/video/audio/PDF input and text output; thinking and function calling supported. Documentation updated October 12, 2026 says the deprecated ID now routes to 3.8 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Published August 13, 2026. Describes a Gemini 3-family model with configurable thinking for coding, agent workflows and video reasoning. Its Architecture section explicitly refers readers to the 3.6 Flash card. Distribution is through hosted Google products and APIs under service terms; no numeric parameter counts appear.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
sources.evidence: Dated August 13, 2026; announces the model that day and gives immediate developer access through Gemini API and Google AI Studio. Identifies it as a Flash-series model from the Gemini team.

sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Page 2 Architecture explicitly points to Gemini 3.5 Flash for architecture details. This is the document directly linked from the exact 3.7 Flash Architecture section.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Page 2 Architecture explicitly points to the Gemini 3 Flash card for architecture details, continuing the official reference chain.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Page 2 Architecture directs readers to the Gemini 3 Pro card; this is an explicit architecture reference, not an assumption based on family membership.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Page 3 identifies sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer architecture. Reached by the explicit architecture-reference chain from 3.7 Flash through 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash and 3 Flash. Does not supply total or active counts for 3.7 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Later September 2, 2026 card includes an exact Gemini 3.7 Flash comparison column. Its comparison reports prices and evaluations, not model parameter totals or active counts; architecture refers back to 3.7 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash Frontier Safety Framework Report
sources.evidence: Exact-model August 2026 report discusses evaluations, supervised fine-tuning, RLHF and probes of internal activations. No production total/active parameter counts or further Transformer dimensions were found in its text.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Service terms, effective March 23, 2026, govern Gemini API access and restrict extracting or replicating the underlying models and weights. Supports proprietary classification for the API-distributed model; page-content licenses are not model-weight licenses.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: August 13, 2026 section records GA release of gemini-3.7-flash. October 8 section records its deprecation and automatic routing to gemini-3.8-flash.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card
sources.evidence: Later October 2026 card checked for retrospective disclosure: no exact 3.7 Flash comparison or parameter-count disclosure was found. No Argon specifications are transferred to 3.7 Flash.

name.note: Exact named model and stable API identifier; distinct from the replacement 3.8 Flash.

developer.note: Google announcement and Google DeepMind model card establish developer ownership.

family.note: Normalized catalog key for the officially identified Gemini Flash series within Gemini 3.

release_date.note: Launch announcement and API GA release notes agree on this day, rather than a later regional listing or deprecation date.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is hosted products/APIs under restrictive service terms; no downloadable checkpoint or open weight license is offered in the model distribution documentation.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the Google service terms governing this model, not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: Undisclosed in the inspected exact-model card and safety report and later first-party comparison/card checks. Targeted exact-name parameter, training and interpretability searches did not locate a production count. No sibling number inferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-per-token count disclosed for this model in inspected sources. Sparse routing establishes neither the count nor equality with total parameters.

architecture.note: Official Architecture references form the explicit chain 3.7 Flash -> 3.6 Flash -> 3.5 Flash -> 3 Flash -> 3 Pro, ending in sparse MoE Transformer. This verifies the broad architecture only; dimensions and expert counts remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Exact documented input token limit for the historical 3.7 endpoint; current requests to this ID are redirected.

modalities.note: Exact model property table lists these supported input types and text-only output.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported at low, medium and high levels.

description.value: Gemini 3-series model with text, image, video, audio and PDF input, text output, configurable thinking, and function calling.
description.note: Uses the exact API capability table instead of generic efficiency or workflow claims.

patch.description: Gemini 3-series model with text, image, video, audio and PDF input, text output, configurable thinking, and function calling.
patch.notes: Architecture verified through the model cards' explicit 3.7 Flash -> 3.6 Flash -> 3.5 Flash -> 3 Flash -> 3 Pro reference chain: sparse MoE Transformer. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed. Google deprecated gemini-3.7-flash on October 8, 2026 and routes this ID to gemini-3.8-flash; listed capabilities describe the original 3.7 Flash model.

sources.label: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
Gemini API Additional Terms of Service

summary: Assessed all 14 public fields: 12 have supported values; total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after exact-model, later-card and training/interpretability checks. Adds proprietary license and MoE architecture through explicit first-party architecture references, replaces promotional description with documented capabilities, and records October 8 deprecation/routing. Release date, context, modalities, reasoning and tool calling are confirmed.
